description: Data underlying the publication: Damage probabilities to power system equipment is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Peng Wang. In order to acquire the precise basic event(BE) probabilities of the damage tree mode, we employed acoustic-solid coupling to simulate underwater explosions on large-scale surface ships under 185 distinct working conditions. The ship equipment deformation was compared with the threshold specified in the BV043/85 standard. Deformation exceeding 4.3 cm is classified as damage. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
